speaker: Kevin J. Hathaway
title: Jesus Christ Is the Great Deliverer!
summary: Elder Hathaway teaches that Jesus Christ, who suffered every kind of affliction, will surely deliver the righteous; the real question is how and when, not if. He gives a four-part pattern of deliverance (opposition, sincere seeking, enabling grace, deliverance in the Savior's time) and illustrates it with a freeway accident at the start of his mission and a missionary, Sister Kenzie Brinkerhoff, whose father died a week before she came home. He asks listeners to hold on through waiting, heed Christ's "Be not afraid, only believe," and trust that deliverance will come, some of it now, some after long waiting, and some in the Resurrection.
